description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named BitmapAllocation that demonstrates efficient bitmap loading by reusing existing bitmap objects to reduce memory usage and garbage collection. It includes logic for loading images, reusing bitmaps via BitmapFactory.Options.inBitmap, and updating the UI accordingly.

classes.name: BitmapAllocation
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating bitmap reuse techniques to optimize memory management and loading performance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up bitmap options, loads the initial bitmap, and sets click listener for reloading images.
